scientific_role: Inspect the already-generated M1-v2 public-I1 inverse-search landscapes without rerunning Optuna, identify whether multiple parameter-diverse near-equivalent local fits exist, and prepare a public-I1-only candidate-selection rule before any M2 graph composition.

allowed: existing M1-v2 search-trial tables generated from public I1
frozen M1-v2 selected-surrogate manifest for provenance only
forbidden: M1 graph-level prediction outcomes for candidate selection
fitted I1 GMM parameters or synthetic samples

existing_search_landscape_policy.providerC_pool_policy: Combine all existing non-smoke 100-trial M1-v2 ProviderC landscapes that use the same public-I1 objective and calibration seed bank, including the original and one declared expanded-bound run. Deduplicate identical parameter vectors.

loss_bands.interpretation: Exploratory local-I1-only bands. This run does not freeze the final compatibility threshold. The final threshold is chosen and frozen after inspecting only these local landscape summaries, before graph composition.

coordinates: log(mean_service_time) normalized to declared search bounds
log(cost_rate) normalized to declared search bounds
service_cv linearly normalized to declared search bounds
diversity.selection: Anchor at the lowest-search-MSE candidate, then greedy farthest-point sampling maximizing minimum distance to already selected candidates; ties prefer lower search_mse then lower trial_number.

next_gate: After reviewing only the local-I1 outputs above, freeze one compatibility rule and re-evaluate the selected diverse candidates on a common 100-trajectory local confirmation bank. No graph or white-box data may be consulted before that rule is frozen.
